generation.scope: In all finite Frobenius windows triple evaluation has rank 16 for projectively identified ends and otherwise 19 or 20. A defect at rank 19 has support length at least nine. Fully asymmetric point-evaluation ideals are generated through degree four. Full triple rank implies an all-degree linear presentation of the quartic point ideal and occurs generically in the fifteen-dimensional mixed component.

open_mathematics: Use the finite point quotient and the point modules of the four-vertex cut to determine the perpendicular pairings, regularity in the stable finite locus and the behavior of rank-nineteen fibers.
